summary: The Baldwin Insurance Group filed an 8-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger under which Parent, a vehicle of Sequence AI Holdings and backed by DFO (Michael Dell's family office), will acquire the company. The structure is a simultaneous LLC merger into Baldwin Holdings and a corporate merger into Parent, followed by a second LLC merger, leaving Baldwin a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Unanimously approved by the board on a special committee recommendation; major Class B holders signed a stockholders agreement. Watch closing conditions, financing execution, and any appraisal or vote overhang.
